messages:
alex: seeing a sudden jump in apiserver 503s in eastus-1, started ~16:12 UTC. etcd leader flipped ~5x in 2m, controller-manager queue piling up. GPU attach backlog up to ~450. graphs: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ctlplane
jen: ack, pulling logs. any recent infra or provisioner deploys?
mike: deploy-bot shows no infra deploys in last 6h. noticed provisioner host churn ~16:09, lots of conn resets from nat-gw-eastus instances.
suzanne: incident-bot: created INC-20260321 for eastus apiserver 503 spike :warning:
alex: copying relevant lines from logs: 
```
etcd: election timeout exceeded, stepping down
apiserver: 503 serving failed: net/http: timeout waiting for response
provisioner: attach_queue_length=452 attach_latency_ms=12000
```
jen: metrics look like keepalive/conn churn -> conntrack near limit. `conntrack_count` peaked at ~61,200 (table size 64k).
mike: short mitigation ideas: throttle attach attempts at provisioner and increase etcd election timeout to reduce leader thrash.
alex: starting a canary throttle: set PROVISIONER_MAX_ATTACH=40 for a small provisioner pool via k8s patch.
alex: running: kubectl patch deployment provisioner -n infra --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"provisioner","env":[{"name":"PROVISIONER_MAX_ATTACH","value":"40"}]}]}}}}'
jen: also requested NAT autoscale for eastus (cloudctl request) — autoscale should add capacity for conntrack/SNAT. ETA ~3m.
mike: bumping etcd election timeout from 1s -> 2s on eastus cluster now, will watch leader stability.
suzanne: moving low-priority model attach traffic to eu-west1 to immediately reduce pressure in eastus (traffic-shift rule applied).
deploy-bot: provisioner canary rollout started (50% pause).
alex: attach queue dropped to ~180 within 90s, apiserver 503 rate noticeably down.
jen: monitoring fd_count, leader_changes, provisioner_attach_latency. running quick grep for 'connection reset by peer' across provisioner logs.
mike: grep shows surge in `tcp_close` on nat-gw hosts, consistent with SNAT exhaustion + aggressive reconnect loops.
alex: follow-ups: open an ops ticket to audit keepalive behavior and connection pooling with cloud attach API; add runbook step to throttle attach rate under conntrack pressure. schedule postmortem if root cause not fully captured.
suzanne: note on cost: NAT autoscale and traffic shift will incur transient cross-region egress and NAT instance costs :money_with_wings:.
finance-ops: okay to proceed with autoscale for stability — please log estimated hourly impact to the ticket.
jen: will collect metrics, annotate grafana dashboards, and attach links to the incident ticket.
alex: thanks everyone. marking thread: observed stabilization, will keep incident open until 2h steady state. updating incident once we confirm stable :white_check_mark:
